title: people-ops-recruiting-coordinator-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-09
content:
TODAY (2026-03-09) - quick runbook / brain dump

Morning priorities:
- 9:00AM: review interview feedback for SDE II (Emily K). Need consolidated notes from interviewers by 10:30. Pinged Miguel (left Slack DM).
- 10:30AM: schedule debrief w/ hiring team (30m) — tentative (Riley, Miguel, hiring mgr). Send calendar invite after feedback is in.
- 11:00AM: follow-up email to Candidate: Andre L (timezone PST) — keep positive, ask for availability for next-stage take-home (2x windows next week). Draft below.

Candidate follow-ups (action items):
- Andre L — send template + take-home instructions + 3 time windows (Mon/Tue next week). (ACTION: send by 11:15)
- Priya S — Offer update: recruiting update from hiring manager says "verbal offer ok" but comp needs finance ok. Flagging to P&O comp team (JIRA REC-482). Follow up w/ Hiring Manager for final comp sign-off by EOD.
- Marcus T — withdrew (candidate), update Greenhouse + notify interviewers.
- SDE IC benchlist — pinged bench recruiter for interest list (waiting).

Interview scheduling / reminders:
- 2026-03-10 14:00 PT — Onsite loop for Backend Eng (remote participants). Confirm Zoom link + interview packet sent. (Reminder: include link to codebase doc)
- 2026-03-11 09:00 PT — Hiring manager 30m screen w/ Priya S (pending comp). Hold provisional invite until comp confirmed.

To-do (short):
- send Andre L take-home (template + instructions)
- update Greenhouse for Marcus T (withdrawn) + move Priya to offer stage pending comp
- follow-up with finance comp-review (email: comp-team@redwood.ai) — escalate if no reply in 4 hours
- prep interviewer packet for onsite (slides + rubric) — use Hiring Playbook v2 (confluence link)
- check expense codes for candidate travel (if offer accepted) — finance doc link in confluence

Notes to self / housekeeping:
- Draft for Andre L email: 
  "Hi Andre — thanks again for your time. We'd like to move you to the next stage (take-home). Attached are instructions + expected turnaround (~72 hours). Please let me know which of the following windows works for you: Mon 3/16 AM PT, Tue 3/17 PM PT, Wed 3/18 AM PT. If you need a different time, happy to accommodate.
  Best,
  Aisha"

- Interviewer feedback reminders: set 48h auto-reminder in GH for this role (manager asked). Check existing workflow (existing GH automation maybe off).
- Keep candidate timezone in mind (Andre PST, Priya GMT+5:30). Use local times in invites.

Blocked / open questions:
- Finance comp response for Priya (REC-482) — if no reply by EOD escalate to L3 HR partner (Miguel).
- Background check vendor switch — Ops asked to delay until next week; if Priya accepts need to confirm vendor timelines.

Misc (brainstorm / scratch):
- Could we batch outbound candidate emails for next-stage invites to reduce manual edits? (template + dynamic fields)
- Remind hiring managers to add 1-line criteria in interview invites (speed up feedback).

End-of-day wrap (what to update in GH + Slack):
- GH: update candidate statuses (Andre = next-stage pending take-home sent; Marcus = withdrawn; Priya = offer-pending-comp)
- Slack: #recruiting-team quick note with status + any blockers for hiring managers

-- quick logs: 
09:02 pinged Miguel (Slack) re: Emily feedback
09:07 pulled interview notes from GH
09:12 DM to Riley re: debrief time
09:20 drafted Andre email (pending final review)

(keep this doc for end-of-day copy/paste into GH notes + Slack update)
